title: Estimating Analyst
description:
Estimating Analyst

Location: London, EC2M 5QQ – office based

Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:30am–4:30pm

Salary: £35,000–£42,000 per annum, depending on experience

Complete Fixing Solutions is an established company in the construction industry, specialising in high-end bespoke joinery installations. We’re looking for someone with estimating experience and an interest in technology to join our commercial team.

You’ll help develop our estimating function, build strong working relationships and introduce practical ways to use AI and digital systems. We’ll provide training in our specialist installation work.

Purpose and objectives of the role

Drive our estimating function forward by digitalising processes and introducing AI, while strengthening relationships across the business, particularly with our directors and clients.

Main duties and responsibilities

  • Introduce AI and digital tools to improve the estimating process.
  • Prepare accurate estimates for enquiries and price variations where required.
  • Attend tender reviews with clients throughout the UK.
  • Build trust with directors through reliable, well-prepared estimates, reducing the time they need to spend reviewing tenders.
  • Take the lead in developing and improving the estimating function.
  • Support the development and implementation of company commercial processes.
  • Ensure bids and estimates are completed and returned within deadlines.
  • Review and adhere to relevant contract terms and conditions.
  • Work closely with colleagues across the business, sharing knowledge and supporting the completion of tasks.
  • Identify and implement improvements to processes and ways of working.
  • Adapt to changing project requirements and timelines.
  • Identify potential new business opportunities.

About you

  • Previous estimating experience in construction.
  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with numbers and data.
  • A practical, logical approach to solving problems.
  • An interest in AI, automation and improving processes.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to build relationships with colleagues and clients.
  • Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn and ask questions.
  • Experience building spreadsheets, databases or automated workflows would be beneficial.
  • A full driving licence and access to a vehicle are required due to the office location and client visits.

Why join us

We’re an established, growing company with a friendly team, delivering prestigious joinery projects. You’ll receive training and support, with the opportunity to take ownership of improving how we estimate our work.

Benefits include:

  • Gold-standard medical insurance.
  • Company pension contributions.
  • Bonus scheme after successful completion of probation.
  • 21 days’ annual leave, plus bank holidays.

To apply, please submit your CV. We’ll contact shortlisted candidates directly, so please avoid calling the office about this role.
